visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen layout. On the left, a close-up focuses on a metal spoon digging into a mountain of fluffy, pure white milk shaved ice in a black bowl. On the right, a male host with short-cropped black hair, wearing a black-and-white grid-pattern shirt over a white tee, takes a large bite with an enthusiastic expression. The setting is a brightly lit indoor eatery with wooden wall panels and a marble tabletop. (2) The scene cuts to a night shot of the restaurant's storefront, which has a minimalist modern design and a lit sign reading "Snow Bro." A yellow banner with "MANGO" text hangs across the window. Next, two white plastic tubs are shown, hand-labeled "NORMAL SIZE" and "LARGE" in bold black marker, illustrating the portions. The lighting is artificial and warm, reflecting off the glass and plastic surfaces. (3) The camera shows the shop's menu board inside, featuring colorful icons and text for various shaved ice flavors. The camera then pans to a bowl of mango shaved ice, where large cubes of vibrant yellow mango are piled high on top of a snowy base. The bowl sits on a rustic wooden tray. The host is visible in the background, seated at a small table, speaking directly to the lens with high energy and hand gestures. (4) The camera shows a glass display case with a small hand-written sign for "Handmade Almond Tofu." Behind the glass, multiple white ceramic bowls are filled with different toppings like red beans, taro balls, and jellies. A spoon is seen scooping more white ice from a large bowl, revealing a yellow jelly-like topping underneath. The environment is crowded with other customers blurred in the background. (5) The host is shown in a medium shot, eating a spoonful of the white ice. As he tastes it, pink animated hearts burst around his face, and variety-style text pops up to emphasize the texture. A female guest with glasses and a red cap is briefly shown in a separate shot, also eating the mango ice with a focused expression. The camera uses quick cuts and close-ups to highlight the food's consistency. (6) In the final sequence, the host continues to eat and talk, looking into the camera with a satisfied smile. The video concludes with a full-screen graphic overlay containing the shop's name, address, business hours, and phone number. The host is seen one last time taking a bite of mango ice from a smaller black bowl. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the indoor scenes.
